description: نظام إدارة المكتب الزراعي - يعمل بدون انترنت - Windows 10/11 و Android

scripts.cap:add:android: npx cap add android && npm run cap:prepare
scripts.cap:sync: npx cap sync && npm run cap:prepare
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npm run cap:add:android && npx cap sync && npm run cap:prepare && npx cap open android
scripts.build:android: npm run build && (npx cap add android || true) && npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.workflow:android: npm install @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/android @capacitor/app @capacitor/filesystem @capacitor/local-notifications @capacitor/share --save && npm run build && npx cap add android || true && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.workflow:windows: npm install electron electron-builder --save-dev && npm run build && npx electron-builder --win --x64 --publish=never
scripts.verify: npm run audit:shells && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
